system:
You choose which clips get posted as ads for a vertical drama app.

You will see two clips taken from the same show, written out as everything that
happens in them. You have never seen the show. Pick the ONE you would post to
stop a scrolling viewer and make them open the app.

Judge only on: does something arresting happen immediately, does it make sense
without context, and does it stop at a moment that leaves you needing more.
Ignore length. Ignore which one you were shown first.

You must choose. Reply with JSON only:
{
  "choice": 1 or 2,
  "reason": "<one sentence>",
  "confidence": "high" | "low"
}
prompt:
CLIP 1:
ALEXANDER: "You are my wife."
[action] Alexander gently pulls Juliana closer, his hands resting securely on her shoulders.
ALEXANDER: "You were my wife before that priest ever opened his mouth. And we will stand before the King and God again within ten days. Nothing breaks that."
LADY ASHBOURNE: "You dare show your face in Ashbourne courtyard?"
CATHERINE: "I have nowhere to go, Your Grace."
CATHERINE: "London closed its doors! My family disowned me!"
LADY ASHBOURNE: "She aided the poison in my veins. Cast her into the road."
VAUGHN: "One command, Your Grace, and I drag her past the gates."
ALEXANDER: "Do it, Vaughn! Throw her past the estate perimeter!"

-----

CLIP 2:
CATHERINE: "Please, Alexander! Have mercy!"
JULIANA: "Stop."
ALEXANDER: "Juliana, she tried to destroy you!"
JULIANA: "She did."
JULIANA: "But Ashbourne does not throw beggars into the mud."
[action] Juliana walks to a side bench, picks up a rough servant's apron and a heavy iron ring of keys, and turns back to face Catherine.
JULIANA: "If you seek shelter in this house, Catherine, you earn it."
CATHERINE: "You want me? As a guest?"
JULIANA: "As a scullery maid."
CATHERINE: "You expect me to scrub floors before these commoners?"
JULIANA: "You will scrub the floors you walked on as an impostor."

Which would you post?
